thread:
mira: Opening a tiny docs PR to clarify Private installer networking for on-prem HSMs. Problem: current example suggests a blanket MASQUERADE which hides caller IPs and breaks HSM audit trails. Need quick review.

 dan: can you paste the exact snippet you plan to add? Infra wants both iptables and nft examples.

 mira: added short iptables example to PR: ```sh
# egress masq except HSM subnet
iptables -t nat -A POSTROUTING -o eth0 -m comment --comment "egress" -j MASQUERADE
iptables -t nat -I POSTROUTING 1 -s 10.20.0.0/16 -d 172.31.99.0/24 -j RETURN
```

 xiao: nit 	6 	INSERT (\-I) places the RETURN before MASQUERADE; that's clearer than appending. For nftables show explicit accept above masquerade.

 mira: updated with nft example: ```nft
table ip nat {
  chain postrouting {
    type nat hook postrouting priority 100;
    ip saddr 10.20.0.0/16 ip daddr 172.31.99.0/24 accept
    oifname "eth0" masquerade comment "egress"
  }
}
```

 dan: please add a preflight check for ip_forward, route to HSM and clock sync. Those are common misses for sealed installs.
\mira: added this preflight snippet: ```sh
sysctl -n net.ipv4.ip_forward || echo "ERROR: ip_forward disabled"
ip route get 172.31.99.10 || echo "WARN: no route to HSM"
date -u; timedatectl show -p NTPSynchronized
```

 xiao: also include a minimal Go SDK example showing client certs to KMS (ops prefer Go).
\mira: added Go example to PR comment: ```go
client, _ := redwood.NewPrivateClient(redwood.ClientOptions{
  KMSEndpoint: "https://kms.internal:8443",
  ClientCert:  "/etc/ssl/client.crt",
  ClientKey:   "/etc/ssl/client.key",
  CACert:      "/etc/ssl/ca.crt",
})
_ = client.Healthcheck()
```

 dan: linkcheck flagged an old HSM docs URL. link-bot suggested replacing /hsm-plugin/ with /integrations/hsm/pkcs11/.
\link-bot: automated suggestion applied to PR #2189: updated HSM link target.
\xmira: changed wording "preserve src" -> "preserve source IP for HSM audit logs" per compliance.

 dan: one last ask 	6 add a tiny netns test script so engineers can validate locally. Low friction reduces support load.
\mira: added test-hsm-netns.sh in PR. Plan to merge after CI green. Thanks!
